n83f2b691e8.headline: Iran’s Economic Collapse Deepens as Regime Policies Drive Negative Growth
n83f2b691e8.summary: Iran's economy is contracting amid inflation and monetary policy failures, deepening poverty and public distrust, according to a report. The source is a niche news outlet and the figures are not independently confirmed here.
n83f2b691e8.why: Iran's economy is shaped by sanctions and oil export constraints, and economic weakness affects regional energy markets and geopolitical risk. Inflation and currency instability are central concerns for investors in the country.

nda53c991fa.headline: State pensioners are 'weighing up options' before shake-up from November
nda53c991fa.summary: UK state pensioners are weighing their options before reforms set out in the Autumn Budget on 26 November. The Chancellor is preparing a new set of changes.
nda53c991fa.why: The UK Autumn Budget sets tax and spending policy, and changes to state pension rules affect public finances and household income. Budget announcements influence gilt yields and sterling.

nc68dc51d11.headline: UK banks 'in eye of the storm' amid US credit jitters and car finance payouts
nc68dc51d11.summary: Investors are focusing on Barclays' results, followed by Lloyds Banking Group and NatWest Group, amid US credit jitters and car finance payouts. UK banks are described as in the eye of the storm.
nc68dc51d11.why: Barclays, Lloyds and NatWest are the major UK-listed retail and commercial banks, and their results signal the health of UK lending. Credit concerns and redress costs such as car finance payouts directly affect their profits.

impacts.name: Barclays
impacts.why: Its results will show how US credit concerns and car finance payouts are affecting profitability.

n5290646f57.headline: Full list of Winter Fuel Payment amounts being paid to each state pension group
n5290646f57.summary: The extended Winter Fuel Payment eligibility covers around 9 million pensioners, or over three quarters of pensioners, according to the published list of amounts.
n5290646f57.why: Winter Fuel Payments are UK government welfare spending, and changes to eligibility affect public finances and household spending.

nc707ed7871.headline: British Gas set to pay £2,000 to certain customers after bill change
nc707ed7871.summary: British Gas will pay £2,000 to certain customers after a bill change, with the Energy Support Fund open to existing customers in energy debt or at risk of fuel poverty.
nc707ed7871.why: British Gas is a major UK energy supplier owned by Centrica, and its customer support measures reflect regulatory and political pressure on household energy costs.

n6fd55b85d1.headline: Power, rent, rates drives NZ inflation up
n6fd55b85d1.summary: Headline inflation in New Zealand edged up again to three per cent, its highest level in more than a period cited in the report. Power, rent and rates were named as drivers.
n6fd55b85d1.why: Inflation readings shape the Reserve Bank of New Zealand's rate decisions, which influence the NZ dollar and local bond yields.

n862b85fbdc.headline: Newsquawk Week Ahead: US, UK, Japan and Canada CPI, Flash Global PMIs, Japan PM Vote
n862b85fbdc.summary: Next week's calendar includes inflation data from the US, UK, Japan and Canada, flash global PMI readings, the Japanese prime minister vote and China activity data.
n862b85fbdc.why: Consumer price index releases and purchasing managers' indices are key gauges of inflation and economic momentum that central banks and investors watch closely.

n5cba344588.headline: Sussan Ley's Liberals promise tax cuts for the next election
n5cba344588.summary: Opposition leader Sussan Ley will commit the Liberal Party to a plan to cut personal income tax at the next election. She acknowledged that budget and economic conditions at that time cannot be foreseen.
n5cba344588.why: Personal income tax policy affects household disposable income, government revenue and the federal budget outlook in Australia.

n335746c5bd.headline: Dublin office woes hit private equity firms from Blackstone to Brookfield
n335746c5bd.summary: Dublin's office vacancy rate has doubled over the last six years, exceeding the 10% reached in Paris and 8% in London and Lisbon. Private equity firms including Blackstone and Brookfield are affected.
n335746c5bd.why: Blackstone and Brookfield are large global alternative asset managers with major real estate portfolios, so office vacancy trends directly affect their property valuations and returns.

ndc7a04f660.headline: Firm based at landmark city attraction underpaid 1,500 staff to tune of £300k
ndc7a04f660.summary: A Birmingham firm based at a landmark city attraction underpaid 1,500 staff by about £300,000, according to a government naming of employers that failed to pay the minimum wage.
ndc7a04f660.why: Minimum wage enforcement affects employers' labour costs and compliance exposure, particularly in sectors with large hourly workforces.

n7b40f71be5.headline: Chinese tech giants pause stablecoin plans after Beijing steps in
n7b40f71be5.summary: Chinese tech giants have paused stablecoin plans after Beijing stepped in. The government raised concerns about the rise of currencies controlled by the private sector, according to the Financial Times.
n7b40f71be5.why: Stablecoins are crypto tokens pegged to fiat currencies, and Chinese regulators' stance affects payments and digital currency policy in the world's second-largest economy.

n23bbafbe4c.headline: Millions more UK households can claim £150 to help with energy bills
n23bbafbe4c.summary: Nearly three million more families would be eligible for the £150 Warm Home Discount next winter under government proposals. The aim is to help households with energy bills.
n23bbafbe4c.why: Energy bill support affects household disposable income and government spending, and shapes demand across the UK energy retail market.

n91afd3b258.headline: Gold likely to consolidate next week as US  data, Fed meeting loom: Analysts
n91afd3b258.summary: Gold prices are expected to consolidate and correct mildly next week after a record-breaking rally looked overstretched. Physical demand is easing after the festive rush, analysts said.
n91afd3b258.why: Gold is a global safe-haven asset and store of value, and its price is influenced by interest rates, the US dollar and central bank policy.

nb1753be7ec.headline: Jensen Huang says Nvidia went from 95% market share in China to 0%—‘I can’t imagine any policymaker thinking that that’s a good idea’
nb1753be7ec.summary: Jensen Huang said Nvidia's share of the Chinese market has gone from 95% to 0%, and criticized policies he said are hurtful.
nb1753be7ec.why: Nvidia designs graphics processors widely used for AI and data centers, so its access to China is a major revenue question for investors.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Loss of China market share reduces a major source of chip sales.

ndce7c1e6f0.headline: Bank heads to open up before 'urgent' rate cut talks
ndce7c1e6f0.summary: Unexpected unemployment figures have led many to expect another interest rate cut in Australia, with key figures set to speak ahead of urgent talks.
ndce7c1e6f0.why: Official interest rate decisions by the Reserve Bank of Australia drive borrowing costs, bank margins and the Australian dollar.

nc6a7e2bff1.headline: Charting the Global Economy: Gold soars amid US-China tensions
nc6a7e2bff1.summary: Gold and silver prices rallied this week amid escalating trade tensions, though silver tumbled on Friday. The IMF noted temporary relief in global growth.
nc6a7e2bff1.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that tends to attract buying when trade tensions and economic uncertainty rise.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Escalating trade tensions drove gold prices higher during the week, as safe-haven demand rose.

n08520e51a2.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to attend APEC CEO Summit in South Korea
n08520e51a2.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang plans to meet global leaders and top Korean executives at the APEC CEO Summit in South Korea this month, the company said in a statement.
n08520e51a2.why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI chips, so its leadership engagement with governments and industry shapes AI infrastructure partnerships.

nedfd322cd1.headline: Early Retirement of Coal-Fired Plants in Pakistan Could Be Economically Viable
nedfd322cd1.summary: A new report shows Pakistan could retire some imported coal power assets early and still save money, according to ProPakistani. The move could be economically viable.
nedfd322cd1.why: Pakistan relies on imported coal for power generation, so decisions on plant retirement affect energy costs and fiscal planning.

n0bd48a3091.headline: Fiscal reforms to steer ‘A’ credit rating – DBCC
n0bd48a3091.summary: The Philippines is on track to secure a single-A credit rating within the decade, according to the Development Budget Coordination Committee, citing fiscal reforms and strong growth.
n0bd48a3091.why: Sovereign credit ratings influence borrowing costs and foreign investment in government bonds.

n03a7c71c3e.headline: Trade war escalates
n03a7c71c3e.summary: The United States and China have been embroiled in a tariff and trade war throughout this year, according to the report.
n03a7c71c3e.why: Tariffs between the world's two largest economies affect global supply chains, trade flows and the earnings outlook of exporters and importers.

ne02d792eb5.headline: ‘Senate won’t allow unprogrammed funds’
ne02d792eb5.summary: Senate President Vicente Sotto III said the Senate will not allow billions of pesos in lump-sum unprogrammed appropriations in the House-approved 2026 national budget.
ne02d792eb5.why: The national budget sets government spending and deficit targets, which affect Philippine sovereign debt and the peso.

n4a7c65a58e.headline: Trump issues grave threat to major ally in menacing online post:
n4a7c65a58e.summary: President Trump issued a threat to Colombia, demanding action against drug production operations, escalating diplomatic tensions.
n4a7c65a58e.why: Colombia is a major producer of illegal drugs, and U.S. pressure can influence regional security and drug trafficking policies.

n2b1ace04c6.headline: Abercrombie Expands U.S. Fulfillment With New Ohio Distribution Hub
n2b1ace04c6.summary: Abercrombie & Fitch plans to open a new distribution center in Ohio, enhancing its U.S. supply chain and e-commerce logistics.
n2b1ace04c6.why: Distribution centers impact retail operations, inventory management, and consumer delivery times.

nce87dfc6ce.headline: Stock market outlook week ahead: Key factors set to drive market action on Monday - Here's all you need to know
nce87dfc6ce.summary: India's S&P BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty 50 reached new 52-week highs, supported by foreign investment inflows.
nce87dfc6ce.why: Strong equity markets attract capital, influence investor sentiment, and reflect economic optimism.

n72d2ae2dc2.headline: Trump Accuses President of Being a ‘Drug Dealer’ in Typo-Filled Post
n72d2ae2dc2.summary: Trump's social media post falsely claims Colombian president is involved in drug trafficking, affecting diplomatic relations.
n72d2ae2dc2.why: Diplomatic tensions can influence regional stability and trade relations, especially in Latin America.

n8300d1ef49.headline: NCLT admits insolvency case against Blu-Smart Mobility over Rs 5.84 crore debt
n8300d1ef49.summary: The National Company Law Tribunal admitted an insolvency case against Blu-Smart Mobility due to default on an operational debt of Rs 5.84 crore.
n8300d1ef49.why: Insolvency proceedings affect company operations, creditor recoveries, and investor confidence in the Indian mobility sector.

n95973b0127.headline: Latvia reports on Chinese business activities, warns of China's biotech strategy | International
n95973b0127.summary: Latvia's security services have long monitored Chinese activities and named China as a potential security risk. Latvia's public radio examined security risks from Chinese investment in MGI Tech, the largest Chinese-owned local biotech company.
n95973b0127.why: Foreign ownership in strategic sectors such as biotech is subject to national security screening, which can affect investment flows and company operations.
